description: ZESFAI crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C88 H96 Dy4 N16 O28 S4,4(C2 H6 O1),3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.673-3.697 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 105.35-106.79°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4(L1)2(L2)2(OAc)4]·4C2H5OH·3H2O (L1 = 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-diamine; H4L2 = 6,6'-(((1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-diyl)bis(azanediyl))bis(((3-ethoxy-2-hydroxybenzyl)oxy)methylene))bis(2-ethoxyphenol)). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
